nina_cs: Heads-up: Seabright onboarding showing steady p95 climb after enabling longer context for chat. Renewal check-in next month, want low-risk perf levers to offer today.
ollie_perf: Can you paste current p50/p95 and average tokens? Also what SLAs/commitment tier do they have?
nina_cs: p50=230ms -> 210ms, p95=1050ms -> 1270ms over last 72h. Avg tokens/request +28%. They're Standard with growth signal. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/seabright/health
rebecca_ml: Two safe plays: A) tenant-scoped split routing: route non-authenticated short replies (<70 tokens) to redwood-lite; B) staged compact-int8 swap only on their tenant ID for generation routes with strict eval gating.
rebecca_ml: Proposed canary: 4% of their traffic (tenant-scoped), 48h window, auto-fallback to redwood-gen-v1 if any quality gate fails.
emily_csm: Seabright asked we avoid their nightly batch at 03:30 local. Can we schedule outside that and include rollback SLA in the note?
ollie_perf: Yes. I'll schedule tenant canary start at 02:00 PT (10:00 UTC) to avoid the batch window. Auto-rollback criteria: p95 worsens >7% absolute or user-facing error-rate + any >3% semantic drift on eval set.
rebecca_ml: Expected outcome: compact-int8 should yield ~12-18% token compute reduction and p50 ~9-12% improvement after warmup on long-gen. Short-path split gives big wins for small interactions. Quality risk low but we run the eval set and a sampled diff deck.
ops-bot: Canary queued: job=canary-seabright-6198887777, tenant=seabright, pct=4, model=redwood-compact-int8-v3, start=6198888000
emily_csm: I'll draft the customer note with conservative numbers (~10% cost save, ~8% latency win), rollback contact and timing. Will also offer a 48h review sync.
nina_cs: Thanks team. After positive canary we'll scale to 25% then full. Please post eval diffs to #eng-ml and attach the small-sample conversation deck for Seabright.
